text:
Maya_CS: Kicking off Citrine pilot thread. Hi all 00: Citrine will pilot our knowledge assist + search for support reps. Quick intros: Maya (CS lead), Ethan (AE), Ravi (SE), Lena (product), and Citrine_Admin (customer).
OnboardBot: Kickoff meeting added: 2026-07-20 09:00 ET (Google Meet link in calendar).
Citrine_Admin: Thanks Maya. Primary business goal: reduce average handle time by 20% and deflect 15% of tier-1 tickets in pilot cohort (10 reps) by Sept 1. Compliance requirement: logs must stay in EU.
Ethan_AE: Confirmed budget for pilot. Customer requests ability to disable external model telemetry and a scoped export policy.
Ravi_SE: Tech note: we can run Redwood Private in EU region with KMS integration. Need a CIDR for VPC peering and an SFTP for CRM dumps. Action: Citrine to share network contact + sample ticket exports.
Lena_Product: Success criteria (measurable):
- 10 reps active for 14 days
- avg handle time reduction >= 15% (goal 20%)
- weekly NPS-like rep satisfaction >= 40 on 0-50 scale
- search precision @5 >= 0.65 on our evaluation set
Maya_CS: Thanks Lena. Adding adoption gating: if 6/10 reps silent after week 2, we pivot to in-field enablement.
Citrine_Admin: We'll provide CSV export and network contact by EOD Tue. Also request a short enablement deck for reps.
Ravi_SE: Technical checklist:
```
- Stand up EU private node (Redwood Private)
- Configure KMS with Citrine keys
- SFTP ingest pipeline for ticket snapshots
- Deploy retrieval+ranker pipeline, enable embeddings with EU-only storage
- Instrument event: conversation_length, action_taken, rep_rating
```
Ethan_AE: Timeline proposal (draft):
30d: infra ready + ingest pipeline + initial 3 reps onboarded
45d: full 10-rep pilot live, rep enablement completed, week-2 pulse results in
90d: analyze ROI, decision thread for expansion or wind-down
Maya_CS: Owners: Maya = CS PM & engagement lead; Ravi = infra lead; Lena = metrics/quality; Ethan = commercial owner; Citrine_Admin = customer sponsor.
Citrine_Admin: How will feedback be captured? Prefer in-app micro-survey and weekly roundup email.
Ravi_SE: We'll front a 1-click micro-survey and export to your mailbox. No PII will be included in summary exports.
Maya_CS: Risks & mitigations (short):
- Delayed cert exchange (owner: Citrine_Admin) -> mitigation: pre-signed cert window + parallel staging
- Low rep buy-in (owner: Maya/Ethan) -> mitigation: 1:1 quick office hours and incentive for early usage
- Search relevance below target (owner: Lena/Ravi) -> mitigation: prompt tuning and relevance eval cadence
Ethan_AE: Renewal sensitivity: If pilot doesn't show usage lift by 90d, commercial will need executive review. Let's make interim check-ins visible to exec sponsor.
Maya_CS: Communication plan: weekly updates (email + summary doc) and bi-weekly show-and-tell demos. First weekly update due 2026-07-27.
OnboardBot: Weekly standup scheduled: Tuesdays 11:00 ET starting 2026-07-21.
Maya_CS: Next steps: Citrine_Admin to send network CIDR + sample exports; Ravi to share EU provisioning ETA within 3 business days; Lena to assemble pilot evaluation spreadsheet; Ethan to invite reps to kickoff.
Citrine_Admin: Sending CIDR and files now. Appreciate the timeline.
Ravi_SE: EU node ETA: 5 business days after we receive creds.
Maya_CS: I'll track these on the onboarding board and nudge if any blockers hit 72h. Ping here for quick escalations. :rocket:
